name: creative-studio
summary: Turn material visual/product decisions into a small set of genuinely distinct concepts. Prefer local SVG/HTML concepts for simple choices; use configured OpenAI image generation for rich mockups; send the selected artifact through vision and implement the chosen direction in the real application.
guidelines: DeepSeek remains the director: decide what decision is useful before generating concepts.
Generate two to four meaningfully different directions rather than cosmetic duplicates.
Use SVG/HTML for simple palette, icon, geometry, and layout choices; reserve image generation for rich visual mockups where it adds value.
If OpenAI image credentials are missing, create a deferred Configuration task and continue with SVG concepts instead of blocking.
After a concept is selected, inspect the selected artifact with vision and translate it into concrete UI implementation constraints.
Verify the implemented application in the browser; a generated mockup is inspiration/evidence, not the finished product.
definition_of_done: the options are visually and strategically distinct
the human can choose from My Tasks or let the safe default resolve automatically
the selected artifact is available to the vision pipeline
the real application is implemented and browser-verified against the selected direction
